stage: First-phase assessment; partial map and explicit unresolved prerequisites

questions.question: How is a mirroring session created?
questions.conclusion: The app/UI imports ScreenSharingSession operations. The media-backed vendor references ScreenSharingSession. Runtime logs corroborate local approval, control activation, remote authentication and media readiness.
limitations: The vendor dossier is truncated by imported-stub mislabeling.
No complete app-to-service call graph or remote server implementation.
questions.next_check: Trace the authorization/enrollment chain before a Windows client.

questions.question: How is the peer discovered and eligibility determined?
questions.conclusion: Production metadata declares RPRemoteDisplayDiscovery with status/RSSI filters. Its source method installs discovery callbacks; runtime logs begin device discovery.
limitations: Advertisement bytes, account filtering and full eligibility policy are unknown.
ScreenContinuityServices Swift parsing reports partial protocol-description errors.
questions.next_check: Recover concrete discovery criteria and transport endpoint handoff.

questions.question: What authorizes locked-screen interaction?
questions.conclusion: The reconnect log reports local authorization, control startup, local revalidation and Sharing authentication completion before media activation. The Mac adapter owns SFAuthenticationManager and pairing/unlock continuations.
limitations: A listCandidateDevices call does not establish the pairing protocol.
Token bytes, key origin, account/host binding and iPhone verification unknown.
Mac entitlements do not prove remote host/hardware checks.
questions.next_check: Follow the concrete SFAuthenticationManager/Sharing enrollment and token-verification chain.

questions.question: Can a fresh Windows host enroll without transplanting Mac trust?
questions.conclusion: No fresh host enrollment or Windows-origin authentication was performed.
limitations: Only an already-enrolled Mac was tested.
Async continuations are only partly followed; Ghidra stub issue remains.
questions.next_check: Recover enrollment operation, persistent key lookup and identity binding.

questions.question: What carried this reference connection?
questions.conclusion: One logged connection uses IPv6 link-local addresses on awdl0, labeled AWDL; the client reports control protocol version 6 and stream ID com.apple.oneness.sessionAndHIDMessages.
limitations: Answer applies only to the selected Mac reference.
Observed ports are transient, not a fixed service contract.
No complete Rapport framing, crypto or transport fallback recovered.
questions.next_check: Determine authenticated transport requirements and whether a Windows-accessible route exists.

questions.question: What serialization boundary exists?
questions.conclusion: Source code calls PropertyListEncoder.encode at 0x2673f4798 and PropertyListDecoder.decode at 0x2673f33c8 within the Mac control implementation.
limitations: Writer/reader end-to-end path, plist format settings, framing and full object graph are unresolved.
CodingKeys alone are not wire-layout proof.
questions.next_check: Recover the typed payload at both encoder and decoder and the ControlTransport send/receive boundary.

questions.question: How is video negotiated and decoded?
questions.conclusion: Production MediaTransportVideoStream declares AVC negotiation/client/stream types. A source method uses network-socket and NWConnection-client transport constructors on separate branches; runtime logs reach audio/video readiness.
limitations: Observed branch, codec, negotiated values, media framing and protection unresolved.
The Ghidra method dossier is incomplete.
questions.next_check: After trust/transport are resolved, recover negotiation writer/reader and frame/decoder parameters.

questions.question: How are pointer, scroll, keyboard and text represented?
questions.conclusion: Production metadata distinguishes system gestures, HID reports/device updates and RTI session/text messages. Native UI accepts clicks and typed search text.
limitations: HID bytes, button/coordinate/scroll/key mapping, orientation and text payloads unresolved.
Scroll automation produced no visible list movement.
UI actions do not identify their wire representation.
questions.next_check: Recover UniversalHID report construction and RTI serialization, then validate against input-specific observations.

questions.question: What ends a session and how does reconnect behave?
questions.conclusion: The native window reports session termination due to iPhone use and requires locking. After user-confirmed lock and Mac authentication, a live connection resumes.
limitations: Physical screen state is user-confirmed.
Teardown wire messages, key reuse and automatic reconnect were not traced.
questions.next_check: Trace invalidation/teardown callbacks and observe a deliberately closed client session if needed.

questions.question: Can a direct Windows session provide native parity?
questions.conclusion: Candidate reconstruction path identified, but no Windows-origin authenticated session, video or input test exists.
limitations: Authentication/enrollment and transport remain unresolved.
No Windows test host is connected.
questions.next_check: Run the focused authorization/enrollment experiment in windows-compatibility.md before designing a minimal Windows probe.

coverage: Mac implementation and selected native runtime events; no Windows or iPhone-server execution.
publication_notice: Curated findings export. Source filenames refer to local original records, which are not included. REA Evidence IDs identify originals, not these derived exports.
